name: Create/edit form in a dialog
summary: Dialog with a labelled form, validation on submit, Cancel + one primary action, and a success toast. One component handles create and edit.
description: For creating or editing a record without leaving the page it belongs to (new task from a board, edit member from a team list). Up to ~6 fields; longer flows belong on their own page or in multi-step-form.
whenToUse: A short form (≤ 6 fields) started from a list, board or detail page.
whenNotToUse: Long or multi-section forms: use a page or multi-step-form.
Confirmations with no input: use AlertDialog.

children.role: noValidate onSubmit; wraps header, fields and footer so Enter submits
Fields, space-y-4; paired short fields in sm:grid-cols-2

composition.role: Once at the app root; call useToast().toast({ variant: "success", title }) after saving

layout: The <form> wraps DialogHeader, fields and DialogFooter so the submit button is inside it.
Footer: Cancel then the primary action, right-aligned.
Reset the draft after a successful save; keep it after a failure.
responsive: Paired fields (priority + due date) are one column on phones, two from sm.
Dialog keeps p-4 inset from the viewport edge; avoid fixed widths larger than max-w-lg.
accessibility: Dialog wires DialogTitle/DialogDescription to aria-labelledby/aria-describedby: always render both.
Each field has a Label htmlFor; DatePicker takes aria-label.
Invalid fields: Input invalid + message via aria-describedby.
states: Saving: disable the submit button. Failure: destructive Alert inside the dialog, keep input. Success: close and show a toast.
antiPatterns: Submit button outside the <form> (Enter does nothing).
